wiki.title: Buffy Wicks
wiki.extract: Buffy Jo Christina Wicks (born August 10, 1977) is an American politician serving in the California State Assembly. A member of the Democratic party, she represents the 14th Assembly District, which includes the cities of Berkeley, Piedmont, Richmond, San Pablo, and El Cerrito in the East Bay.
